query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.twitch_user_id)
                       p.twitch_user_id,
                       COALESCE(p.raid_bot_enabled, 0) AS "partner_raid_bot_enabled!"
                FROM twitch_partners p
                WHERE p.status = 'active'
                  AND p.twitch_user_id = ANY($1)
                ORDER BY p.twitch_user_id, p.id DESC
